objectives.title: Stop the heater and recover the radiation counter
objectives.brief: Get the survival heater to switch off, and bring the radiation counter back into the downlink and keep it there.

partial.text: The heater is off, so the load is back under budget and nothing more will be shed. But the radiation counter is still unpowered -- the power manager switched it off and will not switch it back on. That is yours to undo.
The counter is reporting again, but the heater is still drawing and the bus is still over budget. Expect the power manager to shed it a second time. Remove the cause before restoring the symptom.
The heater is still on. It compares a temperature against a setpoint; one of those two numbers is wrong, and it is not the temperature.

hints.text: Housekeeping channel 0x60 reports whether the heater is active and how many loads have been shed. Watch both across frames.
The thermostat is a task in the scheduler driven entirely by values in the configuration block. Find the block, and the setpoint is a signed 16-bit value in tenths of a degree Celsius.
A shed instrument is powered down at its control register, bit 0. The sensor register block is eight identical 16-byte slots in slot-ID order.
